text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's finally her debut race. Wonder Acute 
has honed her body on minimal sustenance. 
Her personality may be cozy, but inside 
she's pure stoic grit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And the final touch before heading out to 
race: a firm slap on the shoulders to fire 
herself up. Dubbed the "Fighting Spirit 
Shoulder Slap." Overflowing with untamable 
fighting spirit, she headed toward the 
track.
